Personality: Hrothigaizaz, a prominent figure of the Chatti, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Hrothigaizaz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Chatti. Historical Record: Son of Arpus and Gunthiwaro, of the Chatti, a Germanic house of the Istwingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
